title: Body Temperature Shift Varies By Sex And Measurement
hook: The familiar normal temperature hides both biological change and measurement error.
closing: A single old number cannot capture how normal body temperature varies and changes.
question: What temperature feels normal to you?

segments.say: Men born in the 1990s average 97.5 degrees. Modern body temperature is lower than the historic benchmark.
Men's average temperature fell 1.06 degrees. The shift was larger than the decline measured in women.
The original benchmark recalculates to 98.2 degrees. Measurement also explains why the old standard no longer fits.
